# HisaabNow

> AI-powered POS and billing software for Indian small businesses — salons, restaurants, cafes, sweet shops, kirana stores, and pan shops. Tracks real profit (not just revenue) on every sale, supports Hindi voice billing, GST-compliant invoicing, inventory management, staff commission tracking, and an AI business advisor called Munim.

## Company
- Built in Noida, India. Launched April 2026.
- Serves India's micro and small business owners across five verticals: salons, cafes, restaurants, sweet shops, and kirana/grocery stores.
- Pricing: 7-day free trial, then Pro (₹499/month) or King (₹799/month, up to 5 outlets).

## What makes HisaabNow different
- Tracks real profit per sale (cost-adjusted margin), not just revenue — most competitors (Khatabook, Vyapar) show revenue only.
- Hindi voice billing: speak an order in Hindi/Hinglish and it is added to the bill.
- Built-in AI business advisor ("Munim") that flags underpriced items, slow periods, and stock issues in plain language.
